notes.title: Cutthroat Cove Closed BETA
notes.notes:
Ahoy cutthroats!!
After receivin' [b]thousands[/b] o' requests we 'ave decided to give 100 o' ye salty dogs access to our beta branch fer the upcomin' game changin' update. Offer access via e-mail at "lucas@wickedgames.Live". If ye be chosen ye will receive steam beta branch access codes in approximately 1 month. 'appy Treasure Hunting!

notes.title: Big changes be on the 'orizon!
notes.notes:
Thank ye all fer a very successful launch week! I'd like to share with ye some o' the excitin' updates comin' soon to a port nearrr ye. All o' these updates be a direct result o' yer feedback so keep it comin'.
 
[list]
[*]New larger multiplayer map
[*]Quest system with multiple interwoven story lines
[*]Huge NPC update
[*]Points o' interest added to single player map
[*]More weapons
[*]More Upgrades for buildings
[/list]

This here be just the beginnin' o' our voyage through Cutthroat Cove. Keep a weather eye on the 'orizon fer more updates. 

Happy Pirating!!!
